settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Each product page shows the delivery estimate provided by our UK supplier. Your confirmation email repeats it, and tracking follows when your order is dispatched.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Use the tracking link in your dispatch email, or reply to any of our emails with your order number.

settings.question: Can I change my delivery address?
settings.answer: Contact us as soon as possible. If your order has not yet been passed to the supplier we can usually update it.

settings.question: How do I cancel or return an item?
settings.answer: You can cancel within 14 days of receiving your order. Contact us first so we can send you the right returns address — items ship from different UK warehouses.

settings.question: What if my item arrives damaged or faulty?
settings.answer: Contact us with your order number and a photo. Faulty goods are covered by your rights under the Consumer Rights Act 2015.

settings.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: The payment methods available are shown at checkout. Payments are handled securely by Shopify's checkout — we never see or store your card details.
